text:
pagerduty-bot: PD Alert PD-2026-3247 fired for service=inference-gateway-prod — high 5xx rate (5m avg 12%). Link: https://pd.example/PD-2026-3247

alex: acked in PD. i'm on it, grabbing logs and triage. @oncall-rotator i can take this unless you already started.

oncall-rotator: nope, handing off. grabbing dinner, ty <3

sre-bot: automated runbook step 1 triggered: check ingress proxies + kv cache evictions. runbook: https://wiki.internal/runbooks/inference-5xx-spike

maria: looking at region breakdown — eu-west1 shows 502/504 spike, us-west2 normal. rolling window shows 30% of requests hitting model-variant=large-quant.

alex: curl health and quick tail on gateway logs:
```
curl -I https://inference.redwood.ai/v1/health
HTTP/2 502
content-type: application/json

kubectl -n prod logs deploy/inference-gateway -c proxy --since=2m | tail -n 50
[2026-03-15T21:05:12Z] upstream error: connection reset
[2026-03-15T21:05:13Z] 502 returned to client id=...
```

jonathan: can we confirm if this aligns with KV cache evictions? seen that pattern before where evictions cause heavy fanout to model backends.

maria: yes, kvcache eviction rate jumped ~8x at 21:03 in eu-west1. looks like a flaky pod restarted and warmed caches were lost.

alex: temporary mitigation: enable routing-fallback to model-variant=small-quant in eu-west1 for requests > 10 tokens. doing a canary now:
```
curl -X POST https://admin.redwood/api/route -d '{"region":"eu-west1","policy":"fallback-small-quant","percent":10}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED'
```

pagerduty-bot: PD escalation: incident PD-2026-3247 escalated to SRE Lead (10m unresolved, 5xx > 10%).

elaine: taking lead. i'll coordinate with infra to warm caches and add a graceful throttle to the gateway. @maria can you pre-warm top 10 prefixes?

maria: on it — pushing warmup job for frequent prefixes. job snippet:
```
python tools/cache_warm.py --region eu-west1 --prefixes-file top10-prefixes.txt --parallel 8
```

alex: applied 30% fallback to small-quant for eu-west1. monitoring.

sre-bot: metric update — 5xx rate eu-west1 now 7% (down from 12%).

alex: logs show fewer upstream resets. customers: partial impact to long-token generation requests; short responses mostly fine. contacting a few affected customers via support triage.

elaine: good. escalate to eng-runtime if we see recurrence after warmup. opening a short incident issue: https://issues.internal/INC-2312

jonathan: note — we should add guard to avoid full kvcache thrash on pod recycle; i'll file an RFC tomorrow for sticky warmup and faster rebuild.

maria: warmup job completed, caches look healthy on nodes.

alex: 5xx eu-west1 now 2.8% for 5m window. ramping down fallback to 5% then remove if stable.

pagerduty-bot: PD-2026-3247 status: acknowledged -> monitoring.

oncall-rotator: thanks for the handoff, alex. enjoy dinner :)

elaine: i'm going to keep monitoring for 30m then close PD if steady. will add post-incident notes in the runbook. :thumbsup:

alex: +1. no data loss, customer impact limited. closing tasks: follow up RFC and add kvcache protection to runbook.

sre-bot: final metric snapshot before thread freeze: eu-west1 5xx=2.1%, us-west2 5xx=0.4%.

elaine: closing PD in 30m unless we see a regression. thanks all. :wave:
